method: OpenAI built-in image generation, followed by built-in background removal
generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original small raster illustration for a personal website masthead. Image 1 is a STYLE AND DENSITY REFERENCE ONLY: use its two-color pale blue background, dark blue fine contour lines, coarse 1-bit dithering and spare composition. Do not reproduce its character or lettering. Generate a NEW image. Subject: one humanoid mecha robot, a carefully drawn mechanical helmet/head and shoulder/bust in three-quarter view, looking slightly down and toward the left; angular armor, articulated neck, small recessed optical visor, precise panel seams. One articulated forearm stretches horizontally toward the left, echoing the reference's broad horizontal composition. No handheld objects. Style: 1980s Japanese robot manga sketch converted to crisp 1-bit ordered/error-diffusion dithering, delicate dark outlines and sparse stippled shadow, roughly 90% blank pale-blue paper, no heavy black fills. The result must feel like a small classic personal-homepage banner rather than a poster. Canvas: wide landscape about 3:1. Composition: drawing is concentrated in the right-middle of the canvas (helmet around 65% of width); forearm extends toward the left; only head, upper torso and arm, with lower torso naturally cropped by the bottom edge. Use nearly the whole canvas height for the drawing, small top margin, generous blank space left of the helmet. Exact palette intention: background solid #eaf1ff and ink #3d4363, two colors only. No gradients, no smooth gray shading, no photorealism, no 3D rendering, no glow, no scenic background, no anime person, no skin, no hair. Text: none. No letters, titles, logos, signatures, borders or watermark. Reference should guide mark-making and airy density, not subject identity.
edit_prompt: Edit target: the supplied generated mecha website-banner illustration. Change ONLY its pale blue background to genuine transparency. Preserve the exact existing robot drawing, every dark-blue contour, stippled dot and shaded mechanical detail, its composition, position, pose, silhouette, canvas size and framing. Do not redraw, add, remove, recolor or rearrange any mechanical parts. Remove the pale blue paper everywhere, including empty gaps within and between the fingers, arm and mechanical openings. The final asset must contain only the same dark blue line drawing and stippling on a truly transparent background (alpha), ready to place over CSS color #eaf1ff. Preserve tiny dark marks; no white or pale blue halos, no background color, no simulated checkerboard. No text, borders, logos or new objects.
